messages:
Priya: Heads-up — deploying staging group A (service: inference-gateway v3.2.1) at 21:00 PT today. Canary will be 5% for 10m, then 25% for 10m. Need: smoke lead, rollback owner, DB toggle check. Link to runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/deploys/staging-rollback
Oliver: I can own rollback. I'll be oncall window. What are the explicit rollback criteria?
Sasha: I can run smoke tests (latency, 5xx, token-per-request cost). Where's the smoke checklist?
Priya: Smoke checklist script: ```./scripts/smoke_run.sh staging inference-gateway --checks latency,5xx,kps``` Also manual: curl /health, run sample prompt, check KV cache warms.
Keegan: Rollback criteria proposal: 1) 5-minute 5xx rate > 0.5% AND 2) sustained P95 latency increase > 2s vs baseline OR 3) GPU/CPU throttling > 80% for 5m. If any two of three -> rollback. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Oliver: I can own rollback. Prefer shorter path: either 5xx spike OR latency spike triggers immediate rollback for safety. Also add customer-critical routes (/api/generate, /api/chat) — any error spike on those = immediate revert.
Sasha: I'll post smoke run outputs to this thread. Quick Q — what's the kubectl undo flow we should use?
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created by Priya at 2026-03-17T21:00:00Z. Canary policy: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m steps. Runbook: https://redwood.runbooks/deploys/staging-rollback (approved) :white_check_mark:
Priya: kubectl command for revert: ```kubectl -n inference rollout undo deployment/inference-gateway --to-revision=<previous>``` We also have infra fallback: scale previous replicaset and point route to green cluster. Oncall SRE will coordinate LB toggles.
Oncall SRE: I'll be looped for network toggles and LB change. Priya, tag me 15m before so I can shadow.
Keegan: Add Grafana checks: panel 'inference-gateway/errors' and 'inference-gateway/p95_latency' — I'll attach alert thresholds and a temporary dashboard link before deploy. Also route smoke alerts to #incidents if triggered.
Sasha: Any DB or migration toggles?
Priya: No DB migrations. There is a feature flag 'kf.kv_cache_v2' we may enable in canary only if smoke clean. We will NOT flip it to 100% without explicit sign-off.
Oliver: Planning a go/no-go at 21:05 PT after first 10m canary. I'll post final call.
Keegan: Flight plan: Priya deploys -> Sasha runs smoke script -> Keegan watches metrics/alerts -> Oliver calls rollback if needed -> Oncall SRE does LB toggles. Everyone ack?
Priya: ack :white_check_mark:
Oliver: ack :white_check_mark:
Sasha: ack :white_check_mark:
Keegan: ack :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled 10m before deploy (will ping channel).
